Install on all school devices

Odyssey Run opens from one web address, with nothing to download. There are no accounts or servers; records stay in each device’s browser. Pick the way that fits your school.

1. Share the address with students

Show this QR on the classroom screen, or copy the text below to Padlet, Google Classroom or your class app.

The QR button on the game’s home screen also shows a large QR.

2. Chromebooks: force-install from the Admin console

If your Chromebooks are managed in the Google Admin console, one setting puts the app on every Chromebook shelf.

  1. admin.google.com → Devices → Chrome → Apps & extensions → Users & browsers
  2. Choose the students’ organizational unit on the left.
  3. Press + at the bottom right → Add by URL (web app) and enter the address.
    https://gmlduqzhd123-lab.github.io/Odyssey-Run/
  4. Set the installation policy to Force install or Force install + pin to ChromeOS taskbar and save.

Menu names can differ slightly between console versions. It may take minutes to a day to apply; signing in again on the Chromebook speeds it up.

3. Windows laptops (Chrome, Edge)

With Group Policy or Intune, put the value below in the WebAppInstallForceList policy and Chrome or Edge installs the app automatically.

Without a management tool, install on each device as in step 4.

4. Install on each device (1 minute)

  • Chrome, Edge, Whale (PC, Chromebook, Android): open the game and press the install icon at the right of the address bar, or menu → Install app (Add to Home screen).
  • iPad, iPhone: open in Safari, then Share → Add to Home Screen. With an MDM you can deploy a web clip with the same address.

Installed, the game fills the screen, and the browser is less likely to clear records of a site not used for a while.

5. Classrooms with weak Wi-Fi

Before class, press Settings → Island downloads & updates once on each device; all four islands then run without internet.

When students share a device, use Sailors → Create numbered sailors at once to make No. 1 to No. 30. Each student picks their own number.

Records never leave the device. Before resetting a device, back up with Settings → Export whole class.
